patches.name: Catppuccin theme
patches.description: Adds separate Latte and Macchiato themes while preserving the original Boost themes.

patches.name: Boost custom font
patches.description: Uses your TTF font throughout Boost, preserving bold and italic text. No in-app font selector.

options.title: Custom TTF font
options.description: Choose a TTF file to embed as Boost's font. Repatch to change or remove it.

patches.name: Gboard Catppuccin theme
patches.description: Adds a Macchiato keyboard theme with mauve accents, inspired by HeliBoard.

patches.name: Gboard custom font
patches.description: Imports a TTF font and adds it to Gboard's Font selector.

options.title: Custom TTF font
options.description: TTF file path. Choose the font file to embed in the keyboard. Required when this patch is selected.

patches.name: AnkiDroid Catppuccin theme and fonts
patches.description: Replaces Light with Latte and Dark with Macchiato. Adds JetBrains Mono, custom TTF import, and font sizing under Appearance. Selected fonts override card template fonts.

patches.name: Todoist Catppuccin theme
patches.description: Adds separate Catppuccin Latte and Macchiato choices to Todoist's theme picker. Original themes remain available. Catppuccin choices are saved locally.

patches.name: Todoist custom font
patches.description: Embeds your TTF as Todoist's interface font. Repatch to change or remove it. No extra in-app selector.

options.title: Custom TTF font
options.description: Choose the TTF to use throughout Todoist.

patches.name: Fastmail Catppuccin theme
patches.description: Replace Fastmail dark mode with Catppuccin Macchiato and mauve accents. Light mode remains available.

patches.name: Fastmail custom font
patches.description: Use your TTF font in Fastmail's interface. Repatch an original APK to change or remove it.

options.title: Custom TTF font
options.description: Choose a TTF file to embed as Fastmail's interface font.

patches.name: Pocket Casts themes
patches.description: Adds Catppuccin Latte, Macchiato, and restored Radioactivity as separate theme choices.

patches.name: Pocket Casts custom font
patches.description: Embeds your TTF throughout the interface and show notes. Repatch to change or remove it.

options.title: Custom TTF font
options.description: Choose a TTF for Pocket Casts.
